## BlueActions.getVaultV1ReallocationData property

> Warning: This API is now obsolete.
>
> Vault V1 shared-liquidity planning will be removed in the next major. Use .
>

Fetches all on-chain data needed to construct a  for computing vault reallocations via the public allocator.

The target market is refetched internally at `block.number` so the reallocation planner always sees a snapshot from the same block as the source vaults. A caller-owned market would let stale or adversarial data inject unnecessary `reallocateTo` actions (and their PublicAllocator fees) into the resulting bundle.

The returned reallocation data can be passed to  to compute the `VaultV1Reallocation[]` array for `borrow()` or `supplyCollateralBorrow()`<!-- -->.

\*\*Stale data reverts on-chain (fail-safe).\*\*

**Signature:**

```typescript
getVaultV1ReallocationData: (params: {
        vaultAddresses: readonly Address[];
        block: {
            readonly number: bigint;
            readonly timestamp: bigint;
        };
    }) => Promise<VaultV1ReallocationData>;
```

## Remarks

Parameter details:

- `params.vaultAddresses`<!-- -->: Addresses of MetaMorpho vaults that allocate to this market.

- `params.block`<!-- -->: The block to fetch data at (number and timestamp).
